races.name: Human

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: Kamu mendapatkan satu skill proficiency pilihanmu.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: Kamu mendapatkan satu tool proficiency pilihanmu.

races.languageDesc: Kamu dapat berbicara, membaca, dan menulis Common dan satu bahasa tambahan pilihanmu.

races.name: Elf

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Kamu dapat melihat dalam cahaya remang dalam jarak 60 feet seolah-olah itu adalah cahaya terang, dan dalam kegelapan seolah-olah itu adalah cahaya remang.
traits.summary: Lihat dalam kegelapan hingga 60ft seolah-olah itu adalah cahaya remang

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Kamu memiliki advantage pada saving throws terhadap being charmed, dan magic tidak bisa membuatmu tidur.
traits.summary: Advantage pada saves terhadap being charmed; immune to magical sleep

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You can enter a trance for 4 hours to gain the benefit of a long rest.
traits.summary: Meditate for 4 hours instead of sleeping for a long rest

races.languageDesc: You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish.

races.name: Dwarf

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
traits.summary: See in darkness up to 60ft as if it were dim light

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance to poison damage.
traits.summary: Advantage on saves against poison; resistance to poison damage

traits.name: Dwarven Combat Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with battleaxes, handaxes, light hammers, and warhammers.
traits.summary: Proficiency with battleaxes, handaxes, light hammers, and warhammers

traits.name: Tool Proficiency
traits.description: You have proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.
traits.summary: Gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: You have proficiency in History checks related to stonework.
traits.summary: Double proficiency on History checks related to stonework

races.languageDesc: You can speak, read, and write Common and Dwarvish.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.flavorText: Fighters are master of combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty.
features.summary: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: You can take one additional action on your turn.
features.summary: You can take one additional action on your turn.
